text:
sara: quick async: landed a kernel patch that trims mutex hold time; ran staging smoke, p95 latency down ~6%. uploading CI artifact: https://ci.redwood/runs/1234 :eyes:

devin: saw the CI run — failing on the gpu-run job for long-seq repro, OOM at step 42 (only when seq >= 16k)

sara: yep repro is 16k seq. repro steps below:
```bash
bazel run //runtime:local_infer -- --model=redwood-13b --seq=16384 --batch=1
```

morgan: can you try toggling `--kv-cache=partial`? earlier that avoided the full-kv pressure for similar tests

devin: ran with partial KV, OOM gone but p99 tail latency spikes (p50 250ms -> p99 420ms). attaching quick numbers in the thread

bench-bot: snapshot saved: kernel-patch-2026-03-18 -> p50:120ms, p95:330ms, p99:420ms (details: https://bench.redwood/s/789)

lee: blocker: small PR (#4789) touching slot allocator needs review before I can merge release branch. @sara @devin can you take a look?

sara: just added a unit test and responded to comments. hope to have it merged by EOD, pinged reviewers.

morgan: today I'll iterate on the batching heuristic to reduce microbatches for small requests; will drop a diff this afternoon with perf numbers

devin: I'll add a defensive OOM guard in the runtime to gracefully fallback to chunked inference when available memory < threshold

infra-bot: canary deploy completed on shard-7 at 2026-03-18T15:12Z :white_check_mark:

sara: thanks infra-bot. if canary stays green I'll promote later today. no other blockers from my side :thumbsup:

lee: same. added a short note to the handoff doc for oncall: https://docs.redwood/infer/hand-off

morgan: quick question — anyone observed KV eviction causing cold-start amplification after node restart? saw a brief traffic spike when evict scans started

devin: saw that yesterday; I instrumented eviction rate and pushed logs to /var/log/evict-scan.log, looks like aggressive sweep + simultaneous priming caused double work

sara: OK let's watch the canary for 1 hour. if p95 goes >+10% from baseline we rollback. otherwise continue with the batching tweak plan. regroup after lunch if needed.

bench-bot: next scheduled nightly run: kernel-bench-2026-03-19 00:00Z

sara: thanks all, updating thread with any rollforward/rollback decisions.
